text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, E, D, and C above my average cost felt satisfying, but those gains alone do not show whether selling was the best decision.","I made no trades in several periods, and my account value still fluctuated; holding is also a choice with outcomes.","I should judge each future trade on the current decision, not assume recent price moves predict what comes next or let gains and losses versus my cost control me."]}
